name: NRC Health
business_overview: NRC Health provides analytics and insights to measure and improve patient and employee experience for healthcare organizations in the United States. The company offers market experience solutions, a subscription-based services for improved tracking of awareness, perception, and consistency of healthcare brands; assessment of differentiators; and segmentation tools to evaluate the needs, wants, and behaviors of communities through assessments. It also provides patient experience solutions, a cross-continuum multi-mode digital platform that collects and measures data to improve patient experience, engagement, and loyalty; employee experience solutions, which combines health care with technology comprising engagement, pulse, lifecycle, culture of safety, and magnet RN satisfaction; and consumer experience solution that offers online reputation solutions, community insights, and cross-journey listening through nGage. In addition, the company offers Huey, an AI engine built for Human Understanding that serves as a healthcare experience management companion; and governance solutions provided through national conferences, publications, advisory services, and an online portal for not-for-profit health system boards of directors, executives, and physician leadership. Further, it provides patient experience, service recovery, care transitions, employee engagement, reputation management, rounding, and brand loyalty. The company was formerly known as National Research Corporation and changed its name to NRC Health April 2026. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** NRC Health’s core healthcare‑experience platform is capturing strengthening demand, reflected in a record recurring contract value and a return to top‑line growth. The surge was fueled by a landmark multi‑year customer win, which dramatically lifted new sales bookings. However, the large deal is a double‑edged sword: while it promises multi‑phase implementation over several years, the initial ramp is creating near‑term margin compression from delivery and integration costs. Broader healthcare quality‑management and patient‑experience market trends remain favorable, providing a supportive backdrop for sustained expansion as these implementations mature.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is leaning into the growth opportunity with a phased rollout of the major contract, signaling confidence that margin expansion will materialize as implementation scales. The board reinforced this optimism by authorizing a share repurchase program, underscoring a commitment to shareholder returns. Execution risk centers on converting the record backlog into high‑margin recurring revenue without letting expenses spike, a watchpoint that tempers the bullish sales narrative. Management’s tone is upbeat, but near‑term margin pressure will test the credibility of their growth‑and‑efficiency roadmap.

TRCV surpasses $152 million, increasing 6% from the end of 2025 and 13% year-over-year

LINCOLN, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- National Research Corporation, dba NRC Health, (NASDAQ: NRC), a leader in healthcare experience improvement solutions, today announced that it has surpassed $152 million in Total Recurring Contract Value (TRCV) as of March 4, 2026, representing an all-time high in the metric for NRC Health.

TRCV represents the amount of revenue projected to be recognized over the next 12 months from renewable contracts and is calculated consistent with the definition previously disclosed in the company’s periodic reports filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

National Research Corporation (NASDAQ: NRC) achieved a historic financial milestone as Total Recurring Contract Value (TRCV) surged to an all-time high of $152.1 million during the first quarter of 2026. This performance, as reported by Detik Finance, represents a 13% increase compared to the same period last year.

The company's growth was primarily fueled by a landmark multi-year customer acquisition that caused first-quarter sales bookings to skyrocket by more than 200%. Management indicated that this significant deal will be implemented in two distinct phases, scheduled for the third quarters of 2026 and 2027.
